title: Select one meaningful, feasible opportunity to anchor the day
section_label: PHASE 1  |  JOINT FRAMING & OPPORTUNITY  |  60-MINUTE WORKING SESSION
goal: Choose one participant-owned, full-stack opportunity that is valuable enough for Product and feasible enough for Engineering to advance today.
product_shares_1_3_candidate_opportuniti: Product shares 1–3 candidate opportunities, including the target user, problem, desired outcome, known evidence, and context.
facilitator_clarify_the_decision_criteri: FACILITATOR: Clarify the decision criteria and keep the group out of solution mode.
engineering_tests_technical_meaning_like: Engineering tests technical meaning, likely system touchpoints, constraints, and whether a visible implementation path exists.
facilitator_compare_value_feasibility_fu: FACILITATOR: Compare value, feasibility, full-stack depth, and workshop fit.
the_group_selects_one_opportunity_and: The group selects one opportunity and records the rationale, evidence boundary, known constraints, and first slice hypothesis.
facilitator_resolve_or_assign_open_quest: FACILITATOR: Resolve or assign open questions, then confirm the advancement gate.
expected_outcome: EXPECTED OUTCOME  •  One selected opportunity  •  Known evidence and constraints  •  Initial demonstrable-slice hypothesis  •  Clear owners for open questions
